goal: Prevent crafted or corrupted BDB wallet files from causing CPU or memory exhaustion during parsing
Protects users running migratewallet, loading legacy .dat wallets, or using bitcoin-wallet
reviewability: Ready to review now, not a draft and CI has not failed
Each of the three fixes has its own commit and dedicated regression test for independent review
agreement: No reviews or substantive comments yet, only author force-pushes
Crickets: zero distinct reviewers have engaged so far

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it closes concrete resource-exhaustion vectors reachable via normal wallet operations
An 8KB file can hang parsing indefinitely and a 256KB file can drive RSS from 54MB to ~800MB
Not P1 since these are read-only DoS issues, not fund-safety or consensus bugs, and valid wallets are unaffected
